## What should the check find?

Describe in plain words what is wrong when the check fails. (e.g. "Windows devices without a Defender for Endpoint
onboarding")

## Why does it matter?

The risk or the problem it shows, and who would act on it.

## Pack

- [ ] An existing pack: (e.g. RKSolutions Intune Anomalies)
- [ ] A new pack, about: (e.g. Entra ID, Exchange Online)

## How do you check it by hand today?

The admin center page, PowerShell command or Microsoft Graph request you use, if you know it. Mention the permissions
it needs.

## How is it fixed?

What an admin does when the check fails.

## Additional context

Links to Microsoft Learn, blog posts or other references.
